# A family whose gen.emit gives a @generate handler is generated by the
# handler: the walk reads the host at build time, as for a file, and hands the
# handler each member's gen.node value and what it holds. The handler runs in
# the interpreter under the build host, gated as the package that wrote it and
# recorded, and what it writes is stored behind what it read.
env SNGL_GENCACHE_DIR=$WORK/store

sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o out --debug app.sngl
cmp out/blocks.txt want.txt
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.emit'

# Nothing changed: the stored files answer.
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o out --debug app.sngl
cmp out/blocks.txt want.txt
stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.emit'

# A member changed, so what the handler is handed did.
cp app2.sngl app.sngl
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o out --debug app.sngl
! stderr 'gencache hit" req="sngl.emit'
cmp out/blocks.txt want2.txt

# Running a process is the family package's to be granted, not the program's,
# and what it is handed on stdin is the handler's to write.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o outu up.sngl
stderr 'may not run tr a-z A-Z: running it needs --allow-command="\./upper=tr"'
sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o outu --allow-command='./upper=tr' up.sngl
cmp outu/shout.txt wantup.txt

# A raise that leaves the handler is the build's error.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o outr raise.sngl
stderr 'gen.emit @generate: nothing to say'

# A handler writes a path inside the output directory.
! sngl generate --lang go --platform bubbletea -o outr escape.sngl
stderr 'out.write: "../x.txt" is not a path inside the output directory'

-- app.sngl --
import blk "./blk"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const names = ["a", "b"]

blk.bar {
    blk.text(full="first")
    blk.group(name="g") {
        for var n = names {
            blk.text(full=n)
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
-- app2.sngl --
import blk "./blk"
import ui "sngl:ui"

const names = ["a", "b", "c"]

blk.bar {
    blk.text(full="first")
    blk.group(name="g") {
        for var n = names {
            blk.text(full=n)
        }
    }
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
-- want.txt --
first
g
  a
  b
-- want2.txt --
first
g
  a
  b
  c
-- blk/blk.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"

component block build.family

component text(full string) block

component group(name string, items ...component block) block

component bar(blocks ...component block) root

struct Entry {
    text string
}

func lines(members list<gen.Member<Entry>>, indent string) string {
    var s = ""
    for var m = members {
        s = s + indent + m.value.text + "\n" + lines(m.children, indent + "  ")
    }
    return s
}

component block[go.language] {
    gen.emit(@generate(out, members list<gen.Member<Entry>>) {
        out.write("blocks.txt", lines(members, ""))
    })
}

component text[go.language] {
    gen.node(value=Entry{text=full})
}

component group[go.language] {
    gen.node(value=Entry{text=name})
}
-- up.sngl --
import upper "./upper"
import ui "sngl:ui"

upper.shout {
    upper.word(text="hello")
    upper.word(text="there")
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
-- wantup.txt --
HELLO
THERE
-- upper/upper.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"

component loud build.family

component word(text string) loud

component shout(words ...component loud) root

component loud[go.language] {
    gen.emit(@generate(out, members list<gen.Member<string>>) {
        var input = ""
        for var m = members {
            input = input + m.value + "\n"
        }
        var s = ""
        for var line = gen.exec(cmd=["tr", "a-z", "A-Z"], stdin=input).stdout {
            s = s + line + "\n"
        }
        out.write("shout.txt", s)
    })
}

component word[go.language] {
    gen.node(value=text)
}
-- raise.sngl --
import quiet "./quiet"
import ui "sngl:ui"

quiet.host {
    quiet.item()
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
-- quiet/quiet.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"

component fam build.family

component item() fam

component host(items ...component fam) root

component fam[go.language] {
    gen.emit(@generate(out, members list<gen.Member<string>>) {
        error.raise("nothing to say", "quiet")
    })
}

component item[go.language] {
    gen.node(value="x")
}
-- escape.sngl --
import far "./far"
import ui "sngl:ui"

far.host {
    far.item()
}

ui.window {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
-- far/far.sngl --
import build "sngl:build"
import gen "sngl:x/gen"
import go "sngl:language/go"

component fam build.family

component item() fam

component host(items ...component fam) root

component fam[go.language] {
    gen.emit(@generate(out, members list<gen.Member<string>>) {
        out.write("../x.txt", "x")
    })
}

component item[go.language] {
    gen.node(value="x")
}
